+    # Sanitize and truncate a line for display inside fzf so very long
+    # paths or commands don't break table layout. Preserve newlines by
+    # converting them to an arrow marker for the display.
+    def sanitize_for_fzf(text, max_width = 120)
+      return '' if text.nil?
+
+      s = text.to_s
+      # Replace newlines with a visible marker and collapse whitespace
+      s = s.gsub(/\r\n|\r|\n/, ' ↵ ').gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
+      # If terminal width available via ENV['COLUMNS'], use it to set max_width
+      if ENV['COLUMNS'] && ENV['COLUMNS'].to_i > 0
+        term_w = ENV['COLUMNS'].to_i
+        # reserve columns for counts/flags; use at most 70% of terminal width
+        max_width = [(term_w * 0.7).to_i, 40].max
+      end
+      return s if s.length <= max_width
+
+      # Truncate and add ellipsis in the middle for readability
+      half = (max_width - 1) / 2
+      left = s[0, half]
+      right = s[-half, half]
+      "#{left}…#{right}"
+    end
